brand_tagline: Insights that move the world forward

typography_rules.alignment: center preferred, left for data-heavy topics

image_style_rules: NO text, typography, words, letters, or numbers in the image
NO logos, brand marks, or watermarks in the image
cinematic lighting with strong directional light source
one strong central visual metaphor — avoid multiple competing subjects
strong negative space in the lower portion for title text overlay
high contrast between subject and background
photorealistic or premium digital illustration quality
forbidden_elements: AI-generated gibberish text visible in image
safe_text_area: Preserve at least the bottom 40% of the image as clean, lower-contrast area suitable for title text overlay
logo_position: bottom-right corner (handled in Figma, not in AI image)

layout_templates.A: Full-bleed image as background, title text overlay at bottom — best for editorial, general topics
layout_templates.B: Image fills top 60%, solid color band at bottom 40% for title — best for data/analysis/research topics
layout_templates.C: Left-aligned strong image element with open right/bottom space for title — best for opinion/commentary
